Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1384
Claimant:
Christina Ramirez
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
2025-03-31
First notice of loss received from the insured's policyholder reporting a sideswipe while changing lanes on a
multi-lane road. The claimant reports neck and back strain and is not represented by an attorney.
2025-04-27
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver is named on it and that coverage was in force at the time of the loss.
Nothing in the file suggests any damage occurred before the coverage start.
2025-06-12
Photos taken at the scene confirm the general position of both vehicles and the contact area on the body panels.
There are no independent witnesses to the lane change, so the account rests on the parties and the photos.
2025-07-18
Spoke with the claimant, who gave the same account of the lane change and impact as in the initial report. Asked
about seating position in the vehicle at impact; the answer was not fully clear and will need follow-up.
2025-09-01
Reviewed the medical records. The reported neck and back strain fits well with the type and force of the collision. The
records also note a minor strain in the same area several years ago that healed fully, which has been added to the file
for context.
2025-09-06
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this kind of injury. The treating provider's notes are
being requested to undersatnd the course of care. It is not yet clear how much of the total damage came from this
impact alone.
2025-10-06
No prior damage to the vehicle is known from the file or the repair history. Next steps are to obtain the full treatment
notes, request the seating information again, and complete the damage review before setting a settlement position.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
